transcript: Squeeze lime on cucumber and watch what happens. Western doctors stay silent about this. There is no profit in something so simple. Add a few cucumber into your blender. Squeeze in half a lime, add a glass of water, and blend until smooth. In the ancient teachings, cucumber cools what burns inside you. It clears heat from the liver, draws excess fluid from your tissues, and calms the inflammation your body has carried silently for years. The lime cuts through stagnation and moves what you have been holding on to. This drink gives your body what it has been asking for, my friend. Remedies like this fill my book, Time to Heal. Ancient healing methods, practiced in monasteries for centuries, gathered in one place for you. Find it in my profile and begin your healing today.
